record.question: The 13th Finance Commission is headed by
record.explanation: Answer A: Dr. Vijay Kelkar. The Ministry’s original 30 December 2009 announcement identifies Dr. Vijay Kelkar as Chairman of the 13 th Finance Commission when it submitted its report for the 2010–15 period. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=3&relid=56505. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
